title: Inbox Assistant
subtitle: Your newest school mail, sorted by what needs you.

footer.safety: Nothing is sent without your click. Nothing is archived or deleted.

platformOff.title: Inbox Assistant is turned off
platformOff.body: Your school administrator has turned it off. Ask them to enable it, then come back.

connect.title: Connect your Google account
connect.body: Inbox Assistant reads your newest school email from your own Gmail account. Messages stay in Gmail; the app stores only short summaries.
connect.reauthBody: Your Google permission for Gmail has expired or no longer allows reading your mailbox. Connect again to scan.
connect.failed: Could not start Google sign-in. Try again.

firstRun.title: Turn on Inbox Assistant
firstRun.intro: A quiet helper that reads your newest mail and sorts it into what needs a reply, what can wait, and what to ignore.
firstRun.reads: The newest messages in your Gmail inbox, up to the scan size you choose.
firstRun.ai: Sender, subject, date and a shortened copy of the message text. Attachments are never read.
firstRun.never: Nothing is sent, archived or deleted without your click. It only reads and keeps summaries.
firstRun.cost: Every scan has a cost, and you see the exact cost before it runs.

deadlines.checkBody: These dates came from your emails. Confirm the ones that are real.
deadlines.saveFailed: Could not update this deadline. Try again.
deadlines.addFailed: Could not add this deadline. Try again.

events.checkBody: These dates came from your emails. Confirm the ones that are real meetings.
events.endHint: Leave empty to use your default meeting length.
events.saveFailed: Could not update this event. Try again.
events.addFailed: Could not add this event. Try again.

banner.connect: Connect Google Calendar to add these automatically.
banner.reconnect: Google Calendar needs reconnecting before these can be added.
banner.syncOff: Calendar sync is turned off in your settings.

chips.gaveUp: Couldn't add it automatically — do it in Google Calendar
chips.lost: Changed in Google Calendar and left alone

reasons.apiNotEnabled: Calendar is not switched on for this school yet.
reasons.rateLimited: Google is busy. It will try again shortly.
reasons.eventChanged: The event was changed in Google Calendar.

calendar.addFailed: Could not add this to your calendar. Try again.
calendar.removeFailed: Could not remove this from your calendar. Try again.
calendar.decideFailed: Could not save that choice. Try again.

estimate.title: Scan now?
estimate.changed: The estimate changed. Check the new amount before scanning.
estimate.insufficientBody: This scan costs about {{cost}}, but the balance is {{balance}}. Add credit to scan.

empty.needs_reply: Nothing is waiting for your reply.

list.emptyHint: Run a scan to bring in your newest mail.
list.failureKeep: Existing summaries stay visible until the reload succeeds.

row.whyUrgent: This looks urgent, so it is at the top.

settings.title: Inbox Assistant settings
settings.signatureHint: Added after the sign-off when you send a reply.
settings.signaturePlaceholder: Your name, title, or anything you want appended to replies.
settings.includeCcHint: When on, people already on the thread stay in Cc.
settings.nudgeHint: Emails waiting this long are flagged. Choose 1 to 14.

autoScan.title: Automatic scanning
autoScan.intro: Let the assistant scan your inbox on a schedule, so new emails are sorted without a click.
autoScan.enabledHint: Runs in the background at the interval you choose.
autoScan.intervalHint: Choose how often to check for new emails.

settings.saveFailed: Could not save this setting. Try again.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.notConnected: Connect Google Calendar from the Deadlines or Events tab to use these settings.
calendar.syncHint: Confirmed deadlines and events are added to your own Google Calendar. Nothing is shared and no one is invited.
calendar.syncOffHow: Turning this off stops every calendar change from this app. Events already added stay in your calendar.
calendar.autoAddHint: New dates from your email are added without a click. A date that moved or was cancelled always asks you first.
calendar.sendersLocked: Turn on Add automatically to choose who it applies to.
calendar.meetingLengthHint: Used when an email gives a start but no end. Choose 15 to 240.

dateOnly.0: At the start of the day

calendar.overlapEmailHint: One email per scan, listing the new dates that clash with something already in your calendar.
calendar.disconnectHow: To remove this app's access completely, go to your Google Account and open “Security” → “Third-party apps with account access”.

newsletterAutoReply.title: Newsletter auto-reply
newsletterAutoReply.intro: When an email asks for your newsletter section and its deadline is close, the assistant writes a reply from your lesson plans of the last two weeks. You are notified every time.
newsletterAutoReply.risk: I understand this will send an email automatically, in my name, without me reviewing it first
newsletterAutoReply.riskDetail: This feature sends a reply on your behalf without you seeing it first. Only enable if you're comfortable with that.
newsletterAutoReply.deliveryDraftHint: Replies are saved to your Gmail Drafts. You review and send them yourself.
newsletterAutoReply.deliverySendLocked: Automatic sending is not available yet. Replies are saved to Gmail Drafts for you to review and send.
newsletterAutoReply.hoursHint: Reply only when the deadline is due today and within this many hours. Choose 0 to 24.
newsletterAutoReply.checkTimesHint: The assistant checks around these times, in your time zone.
newsletterAutoReply.invalidTime: Write the time as HH:MM, for example 09:30.
newsletterAutoReply.lastTime: Keep at least one check time.
newsletterAutoReply.rolloutNotice: Automatic sending is currently in limited rollout. Your replies will be saved to Gmail Drafts for review.

homeworkAutoReply.title: Homework / what's due auto-reply
homeworkAutoReply.intro: When a parent or student asks what's due, the assistant replies with the real assignment list from the Assignments module — nothing invented. Only registered parents and the students themselves get an answer. You are notified every time.
homeworkAutoReply.risk: I understand this will send an email automatically, in my name, without me reviewing it first
homeworkAutoReply.riskDetail: This feature sends a reply on your behalf without you seeing it first. Only enable if you're comfortable with that.
homeworkAutoReply.deliveryDraftHint: Replies are saved to your Gmail Drafts. You review and send them yourself.
homeworkAutoReply.deliverySendLocked: Automatic sending is not available yet. Replies are saved to Gmail Drafts for you to review and send.
homeworkAutoReply.scopeOwnHint: The safer choice: the reply lists only your own assignments for the class.
homeworkAutoReply.scopeWholeHint: Lists every published assignment for the class, including other teachers' subjects.
homeworkAutoReply.daysHint: List assignments due from today up to this many days ahead. Choose 1 to 14.
homeworkAutoReply.rolloutNotice: Automatic sending is currently in limited rollout. Your replies will be saved to Gmail Drafts for review.

settings.deleteTitle: Delete all my Inbox Assistant data
settings.deleteBody: Removes the summaries, deadlines, drafts and scan records the app stored for you. Gmail is untouched: your messages stay in your inbox.
settings.deleteCalendarEvents: Also remove the events this assistant added to my calendar
settings.deleteCalendarEventsHint: Only the events this app added. Everything else in your calendar stays.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: The summaries, deadlines, reply drafts and scan history stored for you are removed. Your Gmail messages are not touched. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmCalendar: The deadlines and events this app added to your Google Calendar are removed too.
settings.deleteFailed: Could not delete your data. Try again.
